title: Hokkaido vs Kyushu: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Kyushu for transit-dependent travelers, onsen lovers, and history buffs. Hokkaido for serious outdoor adventurers, skiers, and summer nature seekers with a car.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Hokkaido wins on seafood and dairy; Kyushu wins on tonkotsu ramen and yatai street food culture.

categories.name: Onsen & Hot Springs
categories.summary: Kyushu's Beppu and Yufuin are among Japan's best. Hokkaido has Noboribetsu but less variety.

categories.name: Nature & Outdoors
categories.summary: Hokkaido's Daisetsuzan and Shiretoko offer Japan's most dramatic wilderness.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Similar base costs but Kyushu's transit saves on car rental (¥6,000–10,000/day in Hokkaido).

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: JR Kyushu pass (5-day ¥15,000) covers almost everything. Hokkaido needs a car outside Sapporo.

categories.name: Best Season
categories.summary: Hokkaido summer (Jun-Sep) or winter skiing. Kyushu spring/autumn ideal; pleasant even in winter.

categories.name: History & Culture
categories.summary: Nagasaki, Kumamoto Castle, and Dazaifu give Kyushu deeper historical layers.

categories.name: Crowds
categories.summary: Both less crowded than Honshu; Hokkaido especially quiet outside Sapporo peak periods.

categories.name: City Life
categories.summary: Kyushu has Fukuoka, Nagasaki, Kumamoto, and Kagoshima. Hokkaido essentially has Sapporo.

faq.question: Is Hokkaido or Kyushu better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Kyushu is generally more beginner-friendly with better transit. Hokkaido rewards those who can drive.

faq.question: Do I need a car in Hokkaido?
faq.answer: Yes for most highlights outside Sapporo. Kyushu's JR network eliminates the need.

faq.question: Which is better for onsen?
faq.answer: Kyushu wins clearly — Beppu, Yufuin, Kurokawa, Ibusuki are all world-class.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit Hokkaido?
faq.answer: June-September for nature; December-March for skiing.

faq.question: Can you combine Hokkaido and Kyushu?
faq.answer: Yes — fly between them (¥5,000–15,000 on LCCs). Great for 14+ day trips.
